column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_shop.prx (runtime base 0x090ced00, shared slot: registry ids carry the
# rel_shop: prefix, addresses here do not); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: summary

Draws one booster of pack into out (cards_per_pack ids, rare-slot card last). Rarity box: the pack's 20 save entries minus the slots s16[4] at 0x090ef2fc (0,14,4,2) give the remaining rarities; rand % remaining picks r (1-3), stored with save_set_pack_entry(pack, 20 - remaining, r); a full box is cleared first. Rare slot from tier r falling back to lower tiers; commons from tier 0 (or the first non-empty tier) until full, redrawing invalid cards and cards already in the pack; packs 15 and 47 prefer unowned cards (50% rare slot, 30% commons). Random numbers from system_rand_shifted. Side effects: save rarity box, RNG state, heap (temporary lists). Caller: shop_open_next_pack.

column2: int shop_pack_has_card(short card, short * cards, uint count)
column3: 1 when card is among the first count entries of cards, else 0. No side effects. Caller: shop_draw_pack_cards.

Opens one pack of the current cart pack (shop state +0x10): shop_draw_pack_cards, then for each card fills a 0x60-byte display slot (+0x44 card, +0x46 index in fileTbl.dat, +0x48 pack) and counts the opened pack (+2); shop_record_opened_cards. Side effects: shop state, result list, save rarity box. Callers: shop_open_pack_step, shop_open_all_packs.

For every entry of the visit's result list (0x090faa74, 0x090faa7c entries of 10 bytes) calls save_change_card_count(card, 1) copies times: the only place where bought cards enter the collection. Side effects: save collection. Caller: shop_results_exit_step.

Appends the cards of the pack just opened to the result list: a card already listed for the same pack gets copies + 1 (up to 100), new ones are added (list grown by shop_grow_result_list) with copies 1 and counts from shop_fill_result_counts. Side effects: result list, heap. Caller: shop_open_next_pack.
Pack record byte 0 >> 2: 5, or 10 for pack 23. No side effects. Caller: shop_open_next_pack.
Unit price in DP, pack record +4. No side effects. Callers: shop_get_purchase_price, shop_buy_single_step, 0x090e09c4.

Packs per purchase mode: 0 -> 1, 1 -> the packs left on the current pack's shelf (both nibbles of 0x090f9bc0 + pack), 2 -> 20 (table s32[3] at 0x090ef2f0). No side effects. Callers: shop_get_purchase_price, shop_select_purchase_step, shop_buy_shelf_step, shop_buy_box_step.
shop_get_pack_price(pack) * shop_get_buy_quantity(mode). No side effects. Callers: shop_select_purchase_step, shop_buy_shelf_step, shop_buy_box_step.
Pack record +6, the clerk voice index (0-4). No side effects. Caller: shop_play_clerk_voice.

Pack record byte 0 bits 0-1 (sale state copied from the save by shop_load_pack_states; 2 = on sale). No side effects. Callers: shop_play_clerk_voice, 0x090df37c, 0x090e0128, 0x090e0370, 0x090cf578, shop_select_purchase_step, 0x090e09c4.
Percentage (0-100) of the cards of the four tier lists whose collection state (save_get_card_state) is not 0; 0 for an empty pack. No side effects. Caller: shop_load_pack_states.

shop_update_pack_unlocks, then for the 48 packs: sale state into record byte 0 bits 0-1, shop_get_pack_seen_percent into byte 1, the save shelf stock (save_get_pack_stock) into 0x090f9bc0 + pack. Side effects: pack table, shelf array, save pack states. Callers: 0x090d7470, 0x090cf31c, 0x090d7600.
save_set_pack_stock(p, shelf[p]) for the 48 packs. Side effects: save shelf stock. Callers: shop_results_exit_step, 0x090cf578.
Sum of the 48 per-pack cart counters u16 0x090f9afc[p] (packs bought in this visit and not yet opened). No side effects. Callers: shop_play_clerk_voice, 0x090cf578.
First pack index after pack with a non-zero cart counter, -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 0x090d2318, shop_open_pack_step.

Per-frame shop state dispatch on 0x090f9af0. In states < 7 compares new pad presses with the 11-button sequence at 0x090e9ecc (progress 0x090facf4); on completion sets bit 0 of 0x090facf6, calls shop_load_pack_states, plays 0x7a0c and returns 0. In states 9-14 scrolls with the analog stick (shop_scroll_with_analog(0x090faccc)). If the low nibble of 0x090f9b5e is set runs shop_results_exit_step; otherwise (with bit 4 of it clear) dispatches: 6 waits for the fade and silence, then system_set_loading_overlay(1) and returns 1; 8 shop_open_pack_step, then shop_open_all_packs when it returns non-zero; 0xc sort menu; 0xd returns shop_result_card_menu_step(); 9-0xb results list; 3 shop_select_purchase_step; 1 shop_select_pack_step. Returns 1 to leave the shop, else 0 (or the card-menu result). Side effects: those of the step functions. Callers: 1 (shop_run_frame).

Paging of the results list by the pad word +0xc: bit 0x8000 scrolls the top row 0x090faa7e up by 5 (to 0 below 6), bit 0x2000 down by 5 (capped at count - 5, 0 for <= 5 rows), bit 0x1000 shop_results_jump_to_group(1), bit 0x4000 shop_results_jump_to_group(0); each plays 0x7a04. Side effects: scroll globals, sounds. Callers: 1 (shop_results_list_step).

On a confirm-button press (pad word +4 & system_get_confirm_button(1)) toggles the save card flag (save_test_card_byte1_flag / save_set_card_byte1_flag) of the card in the selected result row and plays 0x7a05; otherwise, on button bit 0x8000, opens the results sort menu and plays 0x7a08. Side effects: the card's save flag, the sort menu, sounds. Callers: 1 (shop_results_list_step).

Gets the next group boundary of the results list from shop_results_find_group_boundary (forward passed through in its register; shop_results_page_step passes 1 or 0) and, when found, scrolls so that row is visible in the 5-row window: top 0x090faa7e = 0 and cursor 0x090faa80 = index below 5; top = count - 5 and cursor = index - top near the end; else top = index and cursor 0. Side effects: scroll and cursor globals. Callers: 1 (shop_results_page_step).

Allocates and clears the 0x520-byte opening state 0x090efc00 from heap 0x090facec, opens the card view (ui_card_view_open) with images 0x2023, 0x2025, layout 0x4010, images 0x2031, 0x2030 and the cip reader 0x090facf0, clears the preview block 0x090faccc (0x20 bytes, card -1), initialises the card path, sets opening +0x10 = shop_next_pack_in_cart(-1) and starts a 16-frame fade-in from black. Side effects: heap allocation, card view, fade, shop globals. Callers: 1 (shop_update_counter_step).

Skip of the opening animation: with the opening state *0x090efc00 (+0x10 current pack index, +2 packs opened of it) calls shop_open_next_pack until every pack index < 48 has opened its bought quantity (u16 0x090f9afc + p x 2), frees the opening state from heap 0x090facec and clears the pointer, allocates the result order array 0x090faa78 (u16 x count *0x090faa7c) filled with 0..count-1 and sums the u16 +6 of the 10-byte result entries 0x090faa74 into 0x090faa86, calls shop_update_preview_card, sets 0x090faa82 = 1, 0x090faa84 = 0, calls card_db_get_prop_bits22 for each result card (value unused) and sets the shop state 0x090f9af0 = 9 (results list). Side effects: those of shop_open_next_pack (cards given, save), heap free/alloc, shop globals. Callers: 1 (shop_dispatch_state_step).

Enlarges the result list 0x090faa74 (count *0x090faa7c, 10-byte entries) by extra entries: copies it to a temporary buffer (system_malloc, else heap 0x090facec), frees the old list, allocates (count + extra) x 10 bytes from the heap, copies the entries back and frees the temporary. Returns 1, or 0 when no temporary buffer could be allocated. Side effects: heap/malloc traffic, 0x090faa74. Callers: 1 (shop_record_opened_cards).

For the result entry whose u16 +0 is a card id: byte +8 = how many times the id occurs in the save card list (save_get_card_list_count / save_get_card_list_entry), byte +9 = save_get_card_count(id). Side effects: entry bytes +8/+9. Callers: 1 (shop_record_opened_cards).

Loads the identity matrix, gets model instance 0x8006 (shop_get_model_instance), updates it (field_3d_update_model(model, 0)) and draws it with a 0x34-byte draw parameter block whose first two words are 2. Side effects: model animation state, GE drawing. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_pack_opening).

Draws the pack being opened (model 0x8005): from the current matrix applies translations (0, -6, 0) and (0, 6, 0) around a rotation about x by anim +0x20 and the position anim +0x10 (sceVfpuMatrix4Transfer / RotX), updates the model with frame anim +0x24 and draws it; when that frame is > 0 and the model's frame +0x20 has reached 40.0, clears anim +0x24 and sets the opening state *0x090efc00 = 3. Side effects: GE drawing, model animation, anim, opening state. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_pack_opening).

Draws one card of the pack opening, card = {+0 state, +2 effect timer, +4 card id, +0x10 position vector, +0x20 matrix}: model 0x8004 with the card id pointer stored at opening +0x510 and shop_card_model_texture_callback (field_3d_exchange_draw_state), model matrix = current x card matrix with translation from the position (sceVfpuMatrix4Mul/Transfer), update and draw; in state 3 with a non-zero rarity (card_db_get_prop_bits22) runs shop_play_reveal_effect(timer, matrix, rarity, opening u16 +0x400, EDRAM + 0x160000) and, when it finishes, advances state and resets the timer. Side effects: GE drawing, card state, opening +0x510. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_pack_opening).

Prepares the pack being opened: textures model 0x8005 for pack opening +0x10, model +0x20 = 0, copies the vector at 0x090ea030 to opening +0x20, clears +0x30/+0x34, and for each card (u16 count opening +4, ids at opening +0x44 + i x 0x60) requests its art from the cip reader (card_db_cip_get_image(*0x090facf0, id, save_get_card_value_bits4_6(id))). Side effects: model textures, opening state, image requests. Callers: 1 (shop_open_pack_step).
Copies four words from src to dst and returns dst. Side effects: dst[0..3]. Callers: 1 (shop_init_opening_card_path).

column2: float * shop_eval_quadratic_bezier(float t, float *out, float *p0, float *p2, float *p1)
column3: Quadratic Bezier point out = (1 - t)^2 p0 + 2t(1 - t) p1 + t^2 p2 with the VFPU vector helpers (system_vfpu_vscl_q, system_vfpu_vadd_t, system_vfpu_vector4_copy); the p0 argument of the first scale is passed through (hidden by the decompiler). Returns out. Side effects: out. Callers: 2 (shop_update_opening_card_position, shop_open_pack_step).

Runs the exit/confirm list window 0x090efc04 (ui_update_list_window); when it returns a result: with mode 5 (low nibble of 0x090f9b5e) and result 2 commits the results (shop_commit_results), fades out and sets shop state 0xe; with mode 1 or 2 and result 2 plays clerk voice 6, saves the pack stock, fades out, stops sounds (audio_stop_sounds_bgm_arg(600)) and sets state 6; then resets the window and clears the mode nibble. Side effects: shop state, save writes of the callees, fade, sounds. Callers: 1 (shop_dispatch_state_step).

Draws the shop message list window (descriptor 0x090efc04) into GE list list with ui_draw_list_window(&list, desc) and returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_scene).

column2: void * shop_toggle_texture_state(void *list, int on, int filter_min, int filter_mag, int func, int func_alpha, int wrap_u, int wrap_v)
column3: When on is 1 enables GE state 9 (texture), writes the texture filter (filter_min, filter_mag), function (func, func_alpha), wrap (wrap_u, wrap_v) and texture offset 0, 0; otherwise disables state 9. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_effect_flare, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

column2: void * shop_toggle_depth_test(void *list, int on, uint mask)
column3: When on is 1 enables GE state 1 (system_ge_enable(list, 1)) and writes the depth mask (system_ge_write_depth_mask(.., mask)); otherwise disables state 1 (system_ge_disable(list, 1)). Returns the advanced list left by the last call. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_effect_flare, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

column2: void * shop_toggle_blend(void *list, int on, int op, int src, int dst, uint fix_src, uint fix_dst)
column3: When on is 1 enables GE state 4 (blend) and writes system_ge_write_blend_func(list, op, src, dst, fix_src, fix_dst); otherwise disables state 4. Returns the advanced list from the last call. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_effect_flare, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

Looks up the image member of resource_id (shop_get_image_member) and emits its GIM texture, frame 0, into list with field_3d_gim_emit_texture_frame0; returns that call's advanced list. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

Reads the GUM matrix of mode 1 (view) with system_vfpu_matrix300_store_q, returns to mode 2, transposes it (sceVfpuMatrix4Transpose), clears its translation (shop_clear_matrix_translation) and copies the 4x4 result to out: the inverse view rotation used to face sprites to the camera. Side effects: out[0..15], GUM matrix mode left at 2. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_reveal_effect_small, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

column2: void shop_gum_scale_xyz(uint x_bits, uint y_bits, uint z_bits)
column3: Builds a 3-word vector from the three arguments (float bit patterns) and calls system_gum_scale(&v), scaling the current matrix. Side effects: the current GUM matrix. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

column2: void shop_gum_translate_xyz(uint x_bits, uint y_bits, uint z_bits)
column3: Builds a 3-word vector from the three arguments (float bit patterns) and calls system_gum_translate(&v), translating the current matrix. Side effects: the current GUM matrix. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_effect_flare, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

Reads the GUM matrices of modes 2, 1 and 0 (system_vfpu_matrix300_store_q), multiplies them (sceVfpuMatrix4Mul(t, m1, m2), then (t, m0, t)), restores matrix mode 2 and copies the 4x4 product to out. Side effects: out[0..15], GUM matrix mode. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_effect_flare, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

Copies the 4x4 matrix src, sets its fourth row to (0, 0, 0, 1) and the fourth element of rows 0-2 to 0, and copies the result to dst (sceVfpuMatrix4Copy). Side effects: dst. Callers: 1 (shop_get_billboard_matrix).

Clamps t to 0..total and returns (float)t / (float)total (a negative total is returned as the clamp value when t < 0). No side effects. Callers: 5 (shop_get_inverse_clamped_ratio, shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_reveal_effect_small, shop_draw_effect_flare, ...).

Returns 1.0 - shop_get_clamped_ratio(t, total); the two arguments are passed through. No side effects. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, shop_draw_reveal_effect_small, shop_draw_reveal_effect_large).

column2: int shop_play_reveal_effect(int timer, float *matrix, short rarity, int step, void *edram)
column3: Dispatches the card reveal effect by rarity (card_db_get_prop_bits22 value, shop.md): 1-2 shop_draw_reveal_effect_small, 3 shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium, 4-6 shop_draw_reveal_effect_large, each called with (timer, matrix, step, edram) and its result (non-zero = finished) returned; 0 and other values return 1. shop_draw_opening_card passes the card's timer, its model matrix, the frame step (opening state u16 +0x400) and sceGeEdramGetAddr() + 0x160000. Side effects: those of the effect functions. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_opening_card).
Copies six words from src to dst and returns dst. Side effects: dst[0..5]. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_reveal_effect_large, shop_draw_reveal_effect_medium).

Sets up the shop scene: render state (shop_init_render_state), font shadow and colour codes, font flag 1 on and trim of wrap spaces off when save_get_language() is 0 (else the reverse), end y offset 0, releases the sound banks below the split and loads track 0x2cd, shop_init_clerk(clerk), loads the pack states, creates the speech box (shop_init_speech_box(heap 0x090facec, 2, 0x1dc, 0xe, 0, 0)) and opens it, initialises the DP counter (0x1e0, 2, 0x16a, 2) and fills and opens the list window 0x090faa8c (0x120 bytes, heap 0x090facec, draw callback 0x090dfd30). Side effects: font, sound, clerk, speech box, DP counter and list-window state. Callers: 2 (shop_lib_start, shop_scene_init).

Returns the shop to the counter: frees the result list 0x090faa74 and order array 0x090faa78, reloads the pack states, clears the selected pack 0x090f9b5f, scroll/cursor/count, the 48 purchase quantities 0x090f9afc, 0x090f9af8 and the visit purchase count 0x090f9b5c, re-textures the models 0x8002, 0x8003, 0x8001 for pack 0, reloads the clerk layouts, opens the speech box and sets shop state 0x090f9af0 = 0. Side effects: those globals, heap frees. Callers: 1 (shop_update_counter_step).

Result card menu state *(*0x090f9ae0): 1 returns shop_result_card_menu_close_step(); 0 runs shop_result_card_menu_input() and returns 0; otherwise returns 0. Side effects: those of the callees. Callers: 1 (shop_dispatch_state_step).

Draws the result card menu list window (descriptor *(*0x090f9ae0 + 8)) with ui_draw_list_window(&list, desc) and returns the advanced GE list. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_results_screen).

Resets the result card menu's list window (*(*0x090f9ae0 + 8), ui_list_window_reset), frees it from heap 0x090facec when set, then frees the menu block *0x090f9ae0 and clears the pointer. Side effects: heap frees, 0x090f9ae0. Callers: 1 (shop_result_card_menu_close_step).

Updates the result card menu's list window (ui_update_list_window(*(*0x090f9ae0 + 8))); once the window's byte +0xe9 is no longer 5 frees the menu (shop_free_result_card_menu) and either opens the results sort menu with sound 0x7a08 (window result 2) or returns to shop state 9 (0x090f9af0). Returns 0. Side effects: the menu, shop state, a sound. Callers: 1 (shop_result_card_menu_step).

column2: void * shop_draw_menu_separator(void *list, void *verts, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Fills four 12-byte vertices in verts (colour, x, y, z) for two horizontal lines from x to x + width: colour 0xff479fc1 at y and 0xffa9d7e9 at y + 1; disables texturing, draws them as two 2-vertex line primitives (system_ge_draw_array(.., 1, 0x80011c, 2, ..)) and re-enables texturing. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: verts, GE commands written. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_result_card_menu_items).

libshop_rel start export: clears the shop state 0x090f9af0 (0x1210 bytes), creates a 0x640000-byte heap at 0x090fad00 (system_heap_create, handle in 0x090facec), stores mode in the high nibble of byte 0x090faa70, then shop_init_scene(clerk) (which passes it to shop_init_clerk) and shop_init_archive_state(). Side effects: shop globals, heap creation, those of shop_init_scene. No direct caller (libshop_rel export, reached from rel_story thunk_shop_lib_start in world_state_start_shop).

Shop per-frame update (also the libshop_rel update export): shop_update_counter_step(), then tail-calls shop_dispatch_state_step() and returns its result (1 when the shop is to be left; shop_scene_main loops until non-zero). Side effects: those of the two step functions. Callers: 1 (shop_scene_main).

libshop_rel shutdown export, one stage per call by the low nibble of 0x090f9af2: stage 0 waits until audio_count_se_and_voice_sounds() is 0, then releases sound track 0x2c6 (bit 0 of 0x0973ad50 set) or 0x2c7; stage 1 resets the list window 0x090faa8c, frees the speech box and the DP HUD, closes the card view, frees resources (shop_free_resources), terminates the 3D render state, clears the field_3d allocator and stops the cip reader when 0x090facf0 != 0; stage 2 waits for card_db_cip_is_idle(*0x090facf0), frees the heap 0x090facec and resets the nibble. Returns 1 when finished, else 0. Side effects: those releases and frees, the stage nibble. No direct caller (libshop_rel export, reached from rel_story thunk_shop_lib_shutdown_step in world_state_shutdown_shop).

Module start of rel_shop: when arg is 0 registers the shop scene with system_scene_register(shop_scene_main, shop_scene_exit, 0x0973ad00). Returns 0. Side effects: the scene registration. No direct caller (module entry point).

Start of the shop scene when run as a registered scene: sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000), clears the shop state 0x090f9af0 (0x1210 bytes), creates the 0x640000-byte heap at 0x090fad00 (0x090facec), shop_init_scene(1), shop_init_archive_state(), then loops shop_load_scene_step() with system_wait_frame() until it returns non-zero. Side effects: thread attribute, heap, shop state, loads. Callers: 1 (shop_scene_main).

Main function of the registered shop scene: shop_scene_init(), loading overlay off, frame callbacks (7, 0x090d86f0, 0x090d86f8), loops shop_run_frame() with system_wait_frame() until non-zero, clears the callbacks, loading overlay on, then either calls the scene from the transition record (system_scene_call(target, 4, 0) when system_scene_get_field_8c() is 4) or returns with system_scene_return(7, 0). Side effects: the whole shop session, scene switch. No direct caller (registered by shop_module_start).

Exit function of the registered shop scene: resets the list window 0x090faa8c, frees the speech box and DP HUD, closes the card view, releases sound track 0x2c6 or 0x2c7 (clerk bit 0 of 0x0973ad50) and 0x2cd, stops the cip reader 0x090facf0 and waits until it is idle, then frees the heap 0x090facec. Side effects: those releases and frees. No direct caller (registered with system_scene_register by shop_module_start).

column2: void * shop_draw_number_grouped(void *list, short x, short y, int value, short step, uint digits, int group)
column3: Inside an external font list on list draws value right-aligned: up to digits digits, x moving left by step before each, '0' + value % 10 via shop_draw_number_char, stopping when the remaining value is 0; with group set inserts ',' after every third digit (x moved by step - 3). Returns the list from system_font_end_external_list (shop_draw_cost_panel uses it). Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 3 (shop_draw_results_group_label, shop_draw_pack_price_tag, shop_draw_cost_panel).

column2: void shop_draw_number_char(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_number_grouped).

Writes the 2D drawing state into list: enables GE states 9 and 4 (texture, blend in sceGu numbering), texture function (0, 1), texture filter (0, 0), blend function (0, 2, 3, 0, 0), and disables state 1 (depth test); returns the advanced list from the last call. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 4 (shop_draw_pack_grid, shop_draw_counter_overlay, shop_draw_results_screen, shop_draw_pack_opening).
Copies three words from src to dst and returns dst. Side effects: dst[0..2]. Callers: 1 (shop_setup_opening_fog_view).

Writes the 3D scene state: offset (0x710, 0x778), viewport (0x800, 0x800, 480, 272), depth range (0xffff, 0), blend function (0, 2, 3) with blending off, scissor (0, 0, 480, 272) on, alpha function (6, 0, 0xff) with alpha test off, depth function 7 with depth test on, front face 1 with culling on (state 5), texturing off, shade model 1, clip planes on (state 8), clear depth 0, clear 0x14 and colour 0xff0000ff. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 3 (shop_setup_counter_view, shop_setup_opening_fog_view, shop_setup_opening_view).

Sets the preview card 0x090faccc to the card id of the selected result row (entry order[top 0x090faa7e + cursor 0x090faa80]), or -1 when there is none or the id is 0; when the id changes resets 0x090facd4 to 0. Side effects: 0x090faccc, 0x090facd4. Callers: 2 (shop_results_list_step, shop_open_all_packs).

When the low nibble of 0x090faa70 is 1 and shop_load_secondary_archive_step() returns non-zero, sets that nibble to 2. Side effects: 0x090faa70, those of the load step (archive 0x1002 requested). Callers: 2 (shop_select_purchase_step, shop_update_counter_step).

column2: void shop_draw_menu_item(void *list, ushort *item_def, short x, short y, int width)
column3: Builds the 16-byte menu item descriptor from item_def = {u16 image id, u8 u, u8 v, u16 word number}: image = shop_get_image_member(id), u, v, icon size 0x11 x 0x11, text = card_db_get_dictionary_word(shop resource 0xc001, number), flag 0; then shop_draw_menu_item_box(list, &desc, x, y, width). Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_card_menu_item).
Sums the u16 +6 (copies) of every 10-byte result entry (0x090faa74, count *0x090faa7c) whose card id +0 equals card_id. No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_draw_results_row).

Returns the name of pack (pack & 0xffff) from the pack name table t = shop_get_pack_name_table(): t + t[0] + t[pack + 1] (byte offsets in u32 words). No side effects. Callers: 2 (shop_draw_results_group_label, shop_draw_results_row).

Returns a string from the shop resource 0xc002 (shop_get_archive_member): table t, entry 2 x (pack & 0xffff) + (second == 1), text at t + t[0] + t[entry + 1]. No side effects. Callers: 3 (shop_select_pack_step, shop_select_purchase_step, shop_update_counter_step).

Copies two words from src to dst and returns dst. Side effects: dst[0..1]. Callers: 3 (shop_reset_speech_box, shop_update_dp_delta, shop_change_dp).
Sets the DP counter state 0x098abe3c = 1. Side effects: 0x098abe3c. Callers: 1 (shop_load_scene_step).
